Context: 1. LTC to home town.-

## 1. LTC to home town.-  
(a) Admissible to all employees irrespective of distance between  
headquarters and his home town.  
- (b) Admissible once in a block of two calendar years. The present
- blocks are 2022-2023, 2024-2025 and so on.
- (c) An employee whose family lives away from his headquarters can
- avail this concession for himself every year in lieu of all concessions.  
- GID (9), Rule 7.
